deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 45 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Firmware Version\""
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: return FULL raw `dmidecode -t 45` output filtered to the `Firmware Version` value for that section (raw text, verbatim) so the user can diff against expected; judge correctness/persistence after reboot.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; extracts a formatted version line but not its Type45 string index, format byte or component identity.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds format-aware normalization and inventory correlation but lowers capability for approved inputs.
historical_reviews.round_02: YES; entry 688/2291 retains direct agent collection after operator target selection.

original_test_intent: Validate each Type 45 Firmware Version as the correct version of the intended firmware component, decoded according to its Version Format, and unchanged across an approved reboot.
original_method: Collect complete Type45 records/string areas, resolve the Firmware Version index, decode the per-record Version Format, correlate component and associated handles to authoritative read-only inventory, and compare normalized pre/post-reboot values.
manual_activity: A user supplies the component/version baseline and OEM comparison policy and approves reboot; version extraction, format decoding, correlation and diff are automated.
required_inputs: SMBIOS Type45 capability and format/OEM policy
Validated parser, read-only external inventory and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Read only; do not update firmware or alter boot, BMC or component state.
Preserve the original version string and Version Format byte before normalization.
Do not compare versions lexically or across incompatible formats.
Stop on management or firmware health loss; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate Type45 bounds, string index and Version Format; normalize only by the declared format, map to the approved component and compare pre/post reboot.
Report dangling strings, reserved or unresolved formats, component mismatches and unexplained changes without deciding PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve component/version baseline, format/OEM policy, handle mapping and reboot plan.
Adjudicate vendor-format exceptions and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label filter is relevant but cannot prove the string index, Version Format, record/component association or correct comparison semantics.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive raw and decoded Type45 plus read-only inventory; emit record handle, version index/string, format byte, normalized value, component/handle mapping and pre/post result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The firmware-version scope, script and 5/5-minute values remain; no update action is introduced.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Resolve each Type45 version string, interpret it only under the adjacent Version Format, bind it to the identified component/handles and compare with approved inventory before and after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS Type45 capability, BIOS/BMC, dmidecode/parser and external inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 45 Firmware Version, Version Format and associated-handle definitions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds format decoding and component identity rather than accepting grep text.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects dangling strings, reserved/OEM formats, lexical-comparison errors, wrong-component versions and reboot drift.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OEM formats require owner semantics; Type45 absence is evaluated against platform capability rather than inferred as failure.

project_override_considerations: Projects may define OEM format rules, expected versions and reboot method, but must retain raw version/format evidence and cannot update firmware to make metadata match.
expected_evidence: Approved Type45 capability and component/version/format inventory
Pre-reboot raw records/string areas and version indices/format bytes
Approved reboot and post-reboot semantic diff with health logs

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Firmware Version and its Version Format are defined Type45 fields; missing baselines or OEM rules are project readiness inputs.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Format-aware read-only validation is automatable after approved inputs; reboot approval and final judgment do not reduce capability.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds structure/string integrity, format semantics and component identity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its sound normalization and no-update safeguards while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates required inputs and formal verdict from execution capability.

review_improvement: Prevents a plausible version string from passing when decoded under the wrong format or attached to the wrong firmware component.
independent_technical_reasoning: Type45 version text is not self-describing: correctness depends on a valid string reference, declared Version Format and component association, all of which can be checked deterministically.
